name: utracer3
notes: Ronald Dekker's uTracer3 (400 V class). Values from Dekker's protocol description (dos4ever.com uTracerlog/tubetester2.html §15) where it gives them, otherwise from uTmax 3.01's defaults. Each entry says which.

hv_divider_top_ohm.source: Dekker §15: R2 = 482k, V_HV = 0.35 n (358 V at n = 1023). uTmax 3.01 assumes 470k (rvtop) with RaVal 6800, which reads about 2.4 % low until calibrated.

anode_sense_ohm.source: Dekker §15: 'a current sense resistor of 18 ohm'

supply_volts.source: Dekker §15: cathode referenced to the 18.5 V supply

neg_rail_volts.source: UNVERIFIED placeholder. Dekker §15: negative boost converter measured via R1 = 2k / R2 = 47k to +5 V, V = 0.12 n - 117.5

grid_dac_bits.source: uTmax 3.01 GetVg(): 12-bit word for Nick Barton's firmware 2.03+. Dekker's original firmware: 10-bit PWM, V = -50/1023 n (§15).
